what_could_weaken_view: Revenue growth disappoints at 10-15% — semiconductor equipment capex cycle softens; customers defer MBE orders
ROSIE orders remain at 2-3 total by end of 2026 — BTO silicon photonics standard not adopted by fabs at scale
Aixtron or Veeco announces next-gen MBE competing directly with Riber's production systems — competitive pressure raises
US export controls on semiconductor manufacturing equipment extended to cover MBE systems — reduces addressable market
Riber's factory capacity cannot scale past 15-18 machines/year — structural production bottleneck limits revenue upside
